desc: Leonard and Raj take a look at the bulletin at the hallway together.
Raj, Howard and Leonard notice Sheldon is seated in his office with Missy standing next to him.
Leonard takes a drink from the water fountain.
Howard, in a brown turtleneck, shakes the hand of the woman who stands next to Sheldon.
Missy puts her arm around Sheldon's shoulders.
Leonard stops Sheldon with his arm as he was about to leave.
Penny came in and shows Leonard's superman underwear.
Raj is waving his hand uncontrollably as he greets Missy.
Penny, in yellow blouse, puts the lid on the jar she is holding.
Sheldon, in black shirt, turns from his computer and makes a note in the notebook next to him.
Missy leaves with Penny after getting up from the couch.
Raj, in purple sweater and blue shirt, is standing next to Howard while talking to him and making strange gestures with his hand.
Leonard and Sheldon, in black shirt, walk into Sheldon's room and Leonard closes the door.
Sheldon, in black shirt, flicks his head and points up his finger.
Leonard, in purple hoodie, reaches out and rests his hand on Sheldon's shoulder.
Leonard, in purple hoodie, takes his hand of Sheldon's left shoulder.
Sheldon, in black shirt, quickly spins around, opens the door and leaves the bedroom.
Raj and Howard are wrestling each other on the ground when Sheldon comes in.
Raj, in purple sweater, is sitting at the kitchen island drinking from a green can.
Sheldon is putting mayo on a slice of bread while Raj drinks from a green can.
Howard is holding a bag of frozen peas on his neck while Leonard is scratching his forehead.
Leonard moves Raj's hand down while he wags his hand.
Sheldon picks up a slice of cheese and holds it up in front of Leonard, Howard, and Raj.
Missy closes the door and turns to face Sheldon.
Missy crosses her arms in front of her as she takes a step towards Sheldon.
Missy puts her hand on Sheldon's shoulder and pushes him away form her.
Missy puts her knee onto the bed and sits down next to Sheldon.
Sheldon covers his crotch with his hands as he crosses his legs.
Sheldon slowly walks into the living room as he cups his crotch with both hands.
Howard pours the contents of the jar he is holding into a bowl on the coffee table.
Leonard makes boxing moves as he plays a video game with Howard.
Leonard excitedly jumps up and down with the nintendo controllers over his head.
Penny walks away from the doorway and Missy comes to the door to talk to Leonard.
Howard stands up holding a large yellow sign in front of himself at the doorway.
Howard folds the yellow sign and throws it behind him while standing in the doorway.
Raj turns away from Penny and Missy standing at the doorway, then walks down the stairs.
Sheldon is going downstairs with Missy beside him.
Missy hugs Sheldon and he pats her back awkwardly.
Sheldon follows Missy as she exits the building.
